overview.Module Title: Key Skills for Chemistry and Materials Science

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module equips students with the basic quantitative transferable skills required for level 1 Chemistry and Masterials Science degree programme and general transferable skills with a focus on communication
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Perform calculations as required in analytical chemistry and physical chemistry B. Represent data via graphs, particularly straight line graphs, and regression C. Understand general Health & Safety rules D. Employ transferable digital skills for chemistry E. Present, discuss and debate on a chemistry-related topic
